name: Fort Morgan Oyster Fest
description: The Fort Morgan Oyster Fest is an annual celebration held the last weekend of February at The Beach Club Resort and Spa in Gulf Shores, Alabama. Whether you like oysters naked or dressed to impress, Sassy Bass, The Beach Club Resort and Spa, and Navy Cove Oysters serve up happiness on a half shell with all-you-can-eat oysters prepared multiple ways. The festival features food, fun, and oyster perfection with live music, over 40 arts and crafts vendors, games, contests, and kids' crafts and activities throughout the day. Festival-goers enjoy unlimited oysters with no limits - wear your stretchy pants! A portion of ticket sales and tip jar money is donated to the Alabama Coastal Foundation.
